style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh summer kids-fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, sky blue #EAF4FB, misty grey-blue #BFC9D3, coral-red accent #E4574F and charcoal text #33383D; bright airy soft daylight-style studio lighting with gentle even shadows and soft contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif typography; minimal hand-drawn doodle accents in one accent color kept at frame edges; clean high-key childrenswear photography mixed with soft illustrated infographic elements; stable flat-lay and slight 3/4 product presentation with true-to-life knit texture; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable flat-lay and slight 3/4 presentation, true-to-life knit texture, garments fully visible and unclipped
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper and soft knit fabric surfaces, light cotton textures
style.typography: rounded modern sans-serif with generous letter spacing
